lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice making direct but polite practical requests with kan du and kan jag.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Asking for help with a delivery, pickup, or small service task.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Requesting help and checking whether something is possible.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a package delivery and ask for help picking it up at a suitable time.

main_focus.name: direct requests with kan du and kan jag
main_focus.description: Use kan du to ask another person for help and kan jag to ask what is possible for oneself.
model_examples: Kan du hämta paketet efter jobbet?
main_focus.desired_presence: Use direct request forms naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical delivery words and direct request chunks in a believable exchange.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person explains a package or pickup problem.
dialogue_shape.middle: They ask for help, check opening hours, and clarify what is needed.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree who will pick up the item and when.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat kan du and kan jag in different request contexts

sentence_focus: one sentence with behöver plus an item
one sentence about opening or closing time
one sentence thanking someone for practical help
